difficulty_reason: The author constructs a new legal environment after a component refinement changes input/output alphabets, proves best-effort implementation preservation using actual inclusion of implementation sets, and builds an infimum-defined reward-threshold comparison function for the composed reward semantics. These constructions must handle hopeful input sequences, projected traces, reward-function monotonicity and universal implementation choices. Both actual supporting proof continuations are retained, supporting H2 as one non-routine compositional refinement theorem rather than splitting its clauses or using sketch-only decision bounds.
core_obligations: Retain nonempty refinement, compatibility, monotone comb and exact original no-new-synchronization hypotheses.
Retain complete constructed legal environment and composed infimum-threshold function with all author verification of refinement/compatibility clauses.
Preserve original theorem and Lemma32 source-specific Q-output/Q-input notation difference, do not silently modify author hypotheses or replace a proof by an algorithm sketch.
